## Highlights since 0.16.17

- **Agent fixes.** An Agent thread's notifications now appear only in its own project's window, figures stay out of a simulator dock and the panel no longer goes blank, the slash menu opens above the Context chip, and the Agent is no longer granted device control.
- **Papers grouped by date added.** The Papers library can be sorted and grouped by the date each paper was added, and the grouped list no longer shakes under the pointer.
- **PDF clicks land where you clicked.** Clicking in the PDF now jumps to the paragraph of the word you clicked, never the blank line after it.
- **Windows terminal starts in your project.** On Windows the terminal now opens in the project folder. Thanks to @ivanvykopal for the fix (#988).
- **Faster startup.** Find and Replace now load the first time you open them instead of at startup.

## Notable fixes

- Saving a bibliography writes through a temporary file the Agent's `.bib` guard recognises, so a sandboxed agent can no longer write into it during the save.
- The Markdown visual editor's block controls get their own lane beside the text, the caret has a consistent height, and controls line up with rules, formulas and tables.
- A revision round in which the Agent answered nothing no longer leaves its snapshot behind for the next round.
